scope: U48 Priority A Stage1 production asset approval preparation

assetGroups.recommendation: Lantern and left-hip bag remain most legible at gameplay size without changing Yui's identity.
The short sprout, face mist, and enemy silhouette separate cleanly from Yui and the night field.
The restrained night-street field gives the strongest actor and pickup contrast with the least central decoration.
The paper fragment reads as a small memory piece and stays distinct from healing and candidate crystals.
The restorative bottle communicates manual healing while remaining distinct from EXP and generic heart symbols.
The paper streak gives clear travel direction and stays quieter than the bright runtime spark at density.
The small paper nick communicates impact without masking Onbu or competing with the death effect.
The paper/ink burst is stronger than hit feedback while remaining bounded under density.
Short paper flecks communicate direction with low glow and minimal player occlusion.
Breathing ink edge preserves the irregular bottle identity while keeping the damage radius readable and quiet under projectile density.
Ink shadow plus restrained warm light best separates the streetlamp field from black ink without obscuring enemies or HUD.
The wide dawn ring communicates the evolved scale and dual-source fusion most clearly at all three portrait sizes.
Small ink wisps communicate accumulation without reading as Ready or Active and preserve the normal player silhouette.
The complete dark ring gives the clearest stable Ready signal without prematurely using the full Active flame language.
Controlled black flame provides the strongest phase contrast while remaining bounded around Yui in enemy, projectile, ground-area and HUD overlaps.
Fading soot communicates loss of power and recovery drag with less residual dominance than the longer shadow alternatives.
